newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex shareholders to vote on merger.
newsitem.headline: Budimex shareholders to vote on merger.

text.p: Polish construction company Budimex SA will vote on a merger with its former subsidiary Budimex Trading SA at its extraordinary general shareholders meeting on February 25, Budimex said in a statement.
Budimex said the merger would be carried out by Budimex SA taking all the assets of Budimex Trading but did not give details and no one in the company was immediately available for comment.
Earlier Budimex said it planned to issue new shares to be taken by Budimex Trading shareholders in exchange for its own registered shares.
In December Kredyt Bank bought a 56 percent stake in Budimex Trading from Budimex SA, for 22.4 million zlotys.
Budimex declined to say why it sold the stake and then started preparations to acquire the firm.
